outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 80–96, visible in image and left_ego_image. By frame 100 the door is upright against the oven front; it remains closed after the gripper withdraws and through frame 156. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other side effect is visibly established.
